summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of Dijital Roket backend (FastAPI + MongoDB + JWT) and frontend (React). All 18 backend pytest cases passed (auth, contact, project-request, blog, projects CRUD, admin endpoints, no _id leaks). All frontend flows tested via Playwright passed: home/hero rendering, navigation across 7 pages, project filters, blog/project lists, contact form submission with success toast, project request form success state, mobile hamburger menu open/close, admin login (wrong + correct creds), tab switching, blog post creation via UI, logout redirect.

issues: Whole card is not clickable; only the inner 'Devamını oku'/'Vakayı incele' Link is clickable. Minor UX improvement: wrap the entire <motion.article> in a Link for a larger click target.

action_items: (Optional UX) Make blog and project list cards entirely clickable (currently only inner anchor is). Not blocking.
(Optional) Add data-testid attributes to admin BlogForm/ProjectForm inputs (slug, title, content, etc.) for more robust automation; currently selectors fall back to positional input/textarea queries.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 547-line file mixing models, auth helpers, routes and seed data; consider splitting into routers/, models/, auth.py, seed.py modules for maintainability.

CORS configured with allow_credentials=True together with allow_origins='*' from .env (default). When credentials are used the wildcard origin is invalid per CORS spec; set explicit origin in production.
Admin endpoints use the same get_current_admin dependency which already validates role=='admin' — good. JWT secret comes from env — good.
All responses correctly exclude _id (verified). Pydantic ConfigDict(extra='ignore') used to drop _id from DB docs on response_model serialization.
Seed-admin updates password if it differs — matches playbook requirement. bcrypt hash format verified ($2b$).
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /auth/login (playbook suggests 5-attempt lockout). Not implemented — flag if needed.
Frontend AuthContext stores JWT in localStorage as 'dr_token' (visible in code). For higher security consider httpOnly cookies (playbook preference), though current pattern works for this MVP.
seed_data_creation: No seed needed. Backend auto-seeds 5 blog posts + 4 case studies + admin user on startup. Confirmed counts via /api/admin/stats.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Cleanup is automatic: tests use TEST_ prefixes and the blog/project CRUD tests delete what they create. Manual cleanup of UI-created test data was performed at the end of this run (test blog posts, contacts, project requests with TEST/Test prefixes). Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. JWT in localStorage as 'dr_token'. No brute-force lockout currently implemented; flag if playbook requires.
no_brute_force_lockout_note: Multiple wrong-password attempts return 401 each time; no lockout. Not blocking for MVP.
